entities.summary: Guðrún Ósvífrsdóttir, was an Icelandic woman who was famed for her great wisdom and beauty. She was married four times. She is the main protagonist of the Medieval Icelandic Laxdæla saga, which recounts the history of the People of Laxárdalur. It is widely thought that the saga represents some historical fact.
